headline: Study reveals data centers' long-distance damage to air quality
claim: Electricity demand from U.S. data centers causes premature deaths from air pollution, including far from the data centers themselves.
notes: published 2026-11-19 (page date read via WebFetch). MIT-led study in Environmental Research Letters (Selin, Chen, with UC Irvine and Yale). Model estimate (electricity system model plus chemical transport model plus concentration-response evidence), not a measurement. Figures in the article are for 2023.

headline: Exclusive / AI is disrupting entry-level work, report finds
claim: AI is squeezing entry-level hiring and making it harder for young graduates to start white-collar careers.
notes: published 2026-11-23 (page date read via WebFetch). Report by RAISE US (led by Gina Raimondo) and the Burning Glass Institute, a labor research think tank; same report as the NPR/WLRN row logged 2026-11-25. Reports 3-8% average decline in early-career openings in AI-heavy industries, 2021 to 2026. Interested-party check: the report's producers are labor and policy groups; the report was not opened directly.
